pages: MG-750 Mixer Grinder User Guide and Warranty Card. Sample Appliances Pvt Ltd (a sample document for a lesson; the company and the product are made up). 750 watt motor, three jars, three speeds and a pulse button. page 1

Using your mixer Jars: 1.5 litre liquidising jar, 1.0 litre dry grinding jar, 0.4 litre chutney jar. Do not run the mixer for more than 3 minutes at a time; let it rest for 2 minutes between runs. Always fix the lid before you start. Clean the blades with a brush, never with your fingers. page 2

Warranty The motor is covered for 5 years from the date of purchase. The jars and blades are covered for 1 year. The coupler is covered for 6 months. To claim, show the purchase bill or your online registration. page 3

What the warranty does not cover Damage from running the mixer for more than 3 minutes at a time. Damage from a voltage above 260 volts. Jars that are dropped or broken. Repairs outside the warranty: motor rewinding Rs 1,450; coupler Rs 180; a new 1.5 litre jar Rs 650. page 4

How to claim Call 1800 000 0000 (sample number) or send a WhatsApp message with a photo of the bill. A technician visits within 72 hours in the cities on our list. Register online within 30 days of purchase and the motor gets one more year of warranty. page 5
